strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Full Google hlakola:

• E hlakola Play Store + Google Play ditshebeletso + Services Framework data.
• ⛔ O TLA saenwa tsoa Google diakhaonto (o lokela ho di eketsa hape).
• Dinepe tsa hao le ditiriso tse dingwe ga se tša kgongwa.
• Sedirišwa reboots ka tsela e iketsang ka mor'a.

Na o na le bonnete ba?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: checks the current keybox against Google's revocation list (CRL) and tries multiple sources until it finds a valid keybox, with an automatic backup and a restart of Google services. Runs on every tap and needs internet (1-3 minutes).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox go tšwa go netweke: e taonelouta lepokisi la dinotlelo go tšwa polokelong ya semmušo (GitHub) gomme e e boloka go /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. E hloka inthanete gomme e tšea metsotso ye 1-3. E šomišwa ge go lata ka bohlale go palelwa goba ge lepokisi la dinotlelo le fetotšwe ka seatla.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP tlhahlobo: hlahloba dimmojule tše di lego gona tša Kabo ya Senotlelo sa Kgole, e hlahloba phetolelo ya setifikeiti sa bohlatse sa TEE, gomme e bontšha boemo bja sedirišwa sa KmInstallKeybox. Fetola ha ho letho - e thota sesebediswa boemo pono.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): shows Widevine level indicators (L1/L3) from dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file presence, and related system properties. Modifies nothing at all.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Fixes attestation issues when the automatic pass fails. Every run prints a clear success/failure line.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Handles the hard cases and takes longer. A clear result appears at the end.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: clears Play Store and Google services (GMS+GSF) data and reboots the device automatically. For stubborn attestation only — it never touches your photos or files.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: checks the RKP certificate attestation state of the device and resets the attestation properties if needed. Does not touch user data.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER repair: fixes Google services framework (SOTER) issues related to device attestation. Used for some devices that rely on SOTER instead of Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Applies the selected fingerprint (local/advanced) and updates the pif.prop/pif.json files. A clear result appears in the log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: shows the installed engine state, the fingerprint files (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), and the logs. Check only — it modifies nothing.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Fetches the latest Canary Engine release to ensure compatibility with the mandatory RKP certificates (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: checks the TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), the keybox files (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.
strings.panelKbSlots: 🔐 Di-slot tša Keybox (ya mathomo / ya bobedi) .
strings.hintKbSlots: Mojule o laola di-slot tše pedi tša keybox: ya mathomo (e kgethwa, ga se ya ka ya phumolwa) le ya bobedi (bekapo). Thepo ye e bontšha gore ke sekotjana sefe seo se šomago, e fetoša kgetho, goba e kgothaletša ya bobedi go ya go ya mathomo ka kgopelo ye e lego pepeneneng — ka di-backup le log ye e tletšego.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: checks the TEE key import, the library injection inside keystore2, the revocation status (CRL), the protection-list coverage and the RKP state. Read-only — it changes nothing.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Lenaneo la tšhireletšo le agwa lefsa go tšwa go tirišo ye nngwe le ye nngwe yeo e hlomilwego.
• Llaga ya go sepelelana le ROM ya tlwaelo e dirišwa gape.
• Lepokisi la dinotlelo le le šomago le dirišwa gape.
• Google Play ditirelo di thongwa gape.

Ga go selo e phumotšwe gomme lepokisi la dinotlelo la mathomo ga le ke la kgongwa.

Tšwela pele?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Di-slot tša lepokisi la dinotlelo: e bontšha boemo bja di-slot tša mathomo le tša bobedi gomme e fetoša kgetho magareng ga tšona. Ya mathomo (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) e dula e šireleditšwe gomme ga e ke e phumolwa. Go godiša ya bobedi go ya go ya mathomo go nyaka tiišetšo ye e lego molaleng.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Tšwetša pele sekotjana sa bobedi go ya go ya mathomo:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml e ba dikagare tša sekotwana sa mathomo.
• Ya mathomo ya bjale e bolokwa bjalo ka bekapo pele ga go tšeelwa legato.
• Ga go selo seo se phumotšwego — tshepedišo e a bušetšwa morago.

Tšwela pele?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Hlakola sekotjana sa bobedi:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml e tla tlosoa.
• Sekotwana sa mantlha ha se ama.

Tswela pele?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox lata (e mpsha ka v3.17):

• E hlahloba lepokisi la dinotlelo la bjale kgahlanong le lenaneo la go phumola la Google (CRL).
• E leka methopo ye mentši go fihlela lepokisi la dinotlelo le le hlwekilego le hwetšwa.
• Bekapo ya go itiriša + e thoma gape Google ditirelo.

⚠️ E a hloka inthanete (1-3 mets). Tšwela pele?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Lata keybox go tšwa inthaneteng:

• E taonelouta keybox ya semmušo gomme e e netefatša.
• E hlomilwe sa ruri (ga se ya ka ya bušetšwa morago ge e thoma).

⚠️ E hloka inthanete (go fihla go 1 min). Tšwela pele?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Kabo gape RKP dinotlelo:

• Ga go na data goba difaele tša lepokisi la dinotlelo tšeo di phumotšwego.
• Reboot mogala ka morago ga moo.

Tšwela pele?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Tokiso e feletšego:

• Dipeakanyetšo gape RKP + e thoma gape Google ditirelo.
• Sedirišwa se thoma gape ka go itiriša (ga go selo seo se phumotšwego).

Tšwela pele?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Thoma gape Google ditirelo:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — thoma gape fela.
• Ga go selo seo se phumotšwego gomme o KA SE saene.
• Sedirišwa se thoma gape ka go itiriša.

Tšwela pele?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Kabo ya go gapeletša gape (Red Magic):

• Bakeng sa didirišwa tšeo di hlokomologago lepokisi la dinotlelo leo le dutlilego.
• E šoma le ge dinotlelo di phetše gabotse.
• Ga go na datha yeo e phumotšwego.

Tšwela pele?
strings.confirmCertify:
Force Play Store netefatso:

• Hlakola feela Store cache — akhaonto ya gago ga se ya kgongwa.
• Reboot, ebe bula Store.

Tšwela pele?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER tokiso:

• E thoma gape tirelo ya vendor.soter.
• E hlatswa ya data ya seva ya SOTER fela.

Tšwela pele?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Dira kgatišo ya menwana (PIF):

• E fetolela custom.pif.prop gomme e e tsenya tseleng ya entšene.
• E nyaka go thoma gape ka morago ga moo.

Tšwela pele?
strings.confirmCanary:
Ntšhatša kgatišo ya menwana ya Canary:

• E taonelouta kgatišo ya menwana ya semmušo ya moragorago ya Canary go tšwa go Google.
• E nyalantšha patch ya tšhireletšo + e thoma gape ditirelo tša Google (ga go na go phumola).

⚠️ E hloka inthanete (1-3 min). Tšwela pele?
